mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees under clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a new moon overhead.

City news highlights include a recent residential burglary and weapons offence on September 10. Additionally, the city has posted notices for the upcoming November general election and keeps ongoing engineering updates available online.

It is a busy couple of days in the area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in Verona, followed by yoga on Sunday and trivia starting Monday.
On Wednesday, September 10, Verona officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way. One suspect was apprehended after a firearm was discharged, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:30 PM.
